description: Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke): flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke). Coverage: Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke). The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Tulvariskialueet; Tulvavaaravyöhykkeet, perusskenaariot / Flood hazard zones, basic scen; Havaitut tulva-alueet / Historic Flood Maps; Potentiaalisen tulvametsän tai metsäluhdan esiintymistodennäköisyys 20. Formats seen: ZIP, WMS, ESRI REST, XML, WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
